method: Independent parser of final GLB vertex positions and hierarchy transforms; glTF Y-up transformed to bridge x-longitudinal/y-transverse/z-up. No reliance on revision claims for pass status. Reinforcement: independent read-only final-mesh glTF import, watertight topology, radius-aware containment and cover sampling, exact 3D centreline-segment distances minus outer radii. Final ID-only metadata correction validated by reconstructing exact prior whole-file SHA.
scope: 30 primary girders: 2.00 m depth, 29.57 m edge-span precast length and 29.30 m central-span precast length
6 deck panels: 30.00 m by 12.50 m by 0.10 m; overall double-carriageway deck width 25.50 m
120 transverse diaphragm segments and 120 closure blocks: updated bridge-coordinate stations
20 end bearing pedestals: elevation contact and bottom-face extents within beveled abutment flat-top extents
4 amended abutment stems: contained by footing plan and in vertical contact with footing
Only structural category roots 01 to 09; no road vehicle, train, track or landscape named meshes
15 ordinary longitudinal bars grouped as 5 lower, 4 web, 4 flange and 2 upper erection bars; assigned closed-tie solid enclosure
143 main stirrups and 143 flange ties: actual solid loop closure, stations, diameters and final-concrete outer-envelope cover
3 prestress duct envelopes: concrete containment and clearance from ordinary bars, closed ties and one another
All component IDs unique; 144 copied IDs corrected, with geometry identity independently established
limitations: Geometry and documented teaching dimensions only; no bearing capacity, structural strength, foundation, traffic, or code-compliance validation.
Flat-face extent containment applies to the modeled rectangular abutment and pedestal; this is not a general surface-contact solver.
Reinforcement, bearings and substructure include representational teaching assumptions.
Numeric pass applies to the identified GLB checksum; screenshot composition is reviewed separately.
Reinforcement cover uses final vertices and finite dense radius-aware sampling, not an exact continuous solid Boolean proof.
The revised cage changes teaching bar sizes/count/layout and is not a reproduction of the full original bar schedule.
A 9 mm positive duct-to-bar geometric gap does not certify concrete placing, aggregate passage, minimum construction spacing or reinforcement design.
Asserted counts expand checks across individual objects; they are not distinct engineering design verifications.

reinforcement_results.note: Positive geometric clearances are not construction clear-spacing approval. Ducts are outer void envelopes, not strands. Closed loops omit hooks and bend-radius/anchorage detailing.
